sourceDesc.p: Authority file compiled from the correspondence of Filippo Cavriana.

p.bibl: Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names (vocab.getty.edu). The identifiers were re-derived from Getty in August 2026 and accepted only where the coordinate Getty publishes agrees with the coordinate held here.
Wikidata (wikidata.org). Matches were accepted only where the coordinate corroborates; coordinates, GeoNames identifiers and Getty identifiers were then taken from the matched item.

revisionDesc.change: Vitry-le-François, Châlons-en-Champagne and Marne had all been given Getty's record for Champagne, because the derivation treated a place's region as one of its own names. The two towns now carry their own records; Marne's identifier was removed pending a decision on whether the letters mean the river, the region or the department.

Getty TGN identifiers checked against Getty's own records. Of the 83 distinct identifiers the file carried, 13 did not resolve and 56 resolved to an unrelated place, so they were re-derived from Getty and verified against the coordinates held here. Wikidata and GeoNames identifiers added.
